# Chores Nest: Full Context & Documentation Index (llms-full.txt)

> Chores Nest is an offline-first family organizer and household productivity application. It unifies shared family calendars, chores & task management, real-time synchronized grocery lists, expense & budget tracking, notes & household journals, and an encrypted document vault into a single, cohesive experience.

## Executive Summary & Architecture

- Product: Chores Nest (Family Organizer, Chores & Shared Calendar)
- Operating System: Android (Available on Google Play) & Responsive Web Platform
- Founder & Lead Developer: Shivam Chaturvedi
- Official Website: https://choresnest.com
- Play Store URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.choresnest
- Primary Support Email: support@choresnest.com
- Architectural Model: Offline-First Local Storage with Background Cloud Synchronization. Data is written to device storage first, allowing full uninterrupted offline utility, and synchronizes seamlessly across household devices upon internet reconnection.

## Detailed Feature Modules

### 1. Shared Family Calendar (https://choresnest.com/features/calendar)
- Allows families to schedule shared appointments, school events, medical visits, sports practices, and recurring household events.
- Color-coded member identities ensure each family member clearly visualizes their assigned schedule at a glance.
- Granular permission support allows parents to configure full view and edit rights across members.

### 2. Chores & Task Management (https://choresnest.com/features/tasks)
- Assign domestic tasks, set automated rotation rules (daily, weekly, monthly, or customized frequencies).
- Visual task tracking encourages domestic accountability without nagging or micromanagement.
- Built-in completion histories and reminder notifications.

### 3. Shared Grocery & Shopping Lists (https://choresnest.com/features/lists)
- Instant cross-device synchronization allows multiple family members to view and update shopping lists simultaneously.
- Automatic aisle and department categorization groups items (Produce, Dairy, Pantry, Frozen, Household) to optimize shopping trips.
- Quantity counters, item notes, and one-tap purchase checkboxes eliminate double-purchases and forgotten dinner ingredients.

### 4. Household Finance & Budget Tracker (https://choresnest.com/features/finances)
- Comprehensive expense logging for shared utilities, groceries, child activities, home maintenance, and rent/mortgage.
- Customizable budget categories enable families to monitor discretionary vs. essential living costs.
- Designed with privacy in mind: does not require intrusive bank account logins or financial credential sharing.

### 5. Secure Document Vault (https://choresnest.com/features/vault)
- Secure repository for vital family documentation: IDs, passports, appliance warranties, medical immunization records, and insurance certificates.
- Stored securely on device with local encryption protocols.

### 6. Notes & Household Journals (https://choresnest.com/features/notes)
- Shared repository for family recipes, home maintenance guidelines, babysitter instructions, and emergency contact directories.

## Free Web Tools

### 1. Free Grocery List Maker (https://choresnest.com/tools/grocery-list-maker)
- Interactive web tool for building categorized grocery lists with printable and shareable formats.

### 2. Free Chore Chart Generator (https://choresnest.com/tools/chore-chart-generator)
- Dynamic tool for creating structured, printable family chore schedules with role allocations.
